judged_text: addMembers ships with an in-code TODO ("should clear the input") acknowledging the user-selector is never cleared after a successful add. After adding a batch the stale usernames stay in the input, so the admin must manually clear them before the next batch and a second click of Add re-sends the same names; the field itself never confirms the add happened.

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the `addMembers` action explicitly contains `// TODO: should clear the input` and only calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` without ever resetting `this.usernames` (the `user-selector` input is bound to `usernames` in `group.hbs`). `Discourse.Group#addMembers` also doesn’t clear `usernames`; it only reloads members via `findMembers()`. So the finding about stale usernames persisting and being re-sent on a second click is diff-grounded, but it’s primarily a UX/incompleteness issue rather than a hard correctness defect.
